overview: Global developments include a historic UN court ruling finding Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya minority and a trilateral summit featuring leaders from the US, Russia, and China. In commercial real estate, distress is evident as a major Jersey City office loan enters special servicing and Blue Owl prepares a massive data center deal. San Francisco leaders are reviving the BUILD Act to cut transfer taxes on large real estate sales to unlock stalled housing projects, coinciding with significant local business developments. Meanwhile, in Hawaii, the newly elected Kaua'i County Council has chosen its leadership.

items.title: Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya minority, top UN court rules
items.summary: The International Court of Justice has ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya minority during a 2017 military crackdown.

items.title: Trump, Putin and Xi release 'peace declaration' after historic meeting
items.summary: Presidents Trump, Putin, and Xi released a peace declaration following their historic first trilateral discussion.

items.title: $250M CMBS Loan Backed by Jersey City’s 101 Hudson Street Sent to Special Servicing
items.summary: A $250 million CMBS loan backed by Jersey City's 101 Hudson Street office building was sent to special servicing after missing its maturity date.

items.title: Mayor Lurie, Supervisor Mahmood revive plan to cut taxes on big S.F. real estate sales
items.summary: Mayor Daniel Lurie and Supervisor Bilal Mahmood have revived a plan to cut taxes on large San Francisco real estate sales.

items.title: SF leaders revive plan to unlock stalled housing projects. Here’s how it would work
items.summary: San Francisco leaders are bringing back the BUILD Act to cut transfer taxes on large real estate transactions and unlock stalled housing.

items.title: Newly Elected Kaua‘i County Council Chooses Leadership
items.summary: The newly elected Kaua'i County Council selected incumbents Arryl Kaneshiro and Fern Holland to lead the council.

items.title: Commission Keeps Maui Police Chief On Leave Amid Corruption Probe
items.summary: The Maui Police Commission declined to reinstate Maui Police Chief John Pelletier while an investigation into a department unit continues.

wiki.title: Iron Gate (Antioch)
wiki.extract: The Iron Gate is a sixth-century dam located in the mountains to the east of Antakya in Turkey. It is one of the earliest known arch dams and is the oldest to survive. It was built in the mid–sixth century on the order of the Byzantine emperor Justinian I to impound and slow the waters of the Parmenios stream, which in the rainy season could cause torrential floods endangering Antioch's city centre. Previous attempts to channel the floodwaters into underground passageways had not fully solved the problem.
